title: Agave Americana
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of scurvy, with much weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of dropsy and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general soreness and tenderness of the body. Gums swollen, bleeding, and sore. Tongue pale and flabby. Appetite poor. Nausea. Burning in the stomach. Distended and tender. Chronic diarrhoea of thin, watery stools. Pale and waxen. Petechiae. Scurvy. Compare: Arsenicum; China; Phosphorus. Tincture to third potency.
